summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing a routine daily repurchase of its own shares for cancellation, part of a buy-back program announced on 5 August 2026. On 3 September 2026, HSBC purchased 10,000 shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of GBP 15.5481 per share, and 440,000 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$163.4813 per share. Since program commencement, HSBC has repurchased 25,616,214 shares for approximately US$527.5 million. Repurchases are executed on-exchange through BNP Paribas. The company reports total issued share capital of 17,166,063,783 shares following cancellation.
